# On and off by default — the `security-ts` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#security-ts).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — a security pack is chosen, not detected.
- **Rules:** 16 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 16 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `sec-ts/recommended` | no — opt in | 67 | 67 error | sec-js/recommended and the high-confidence TypeScript-only security rules, at error |
| `sec-ts/strict` | no — opt in | 84 | 67 error, 17 warn | sec-js/strict, sec-ts/recommended and the heuristic TypeScript-only security rules, at warn |

## Rules
